title.value: CKEditor in Drupal: From Better Formatting to AI-Powered Authoring

summary.value: Lightning talk at DrupalCon Chicago 2026 - the latest CKEditor 5 improvements in the Drupal ecosystem, from enhanced formatting capabilities to the AI-powered authoring features now available in production Drupal sites.

value.description: CKEditor in Drupal: From Better Formatting to AI-Powered Authoring

content.value:
What this lightning talk covered

A fast-paced walkthrough of what's new in CKEditor 5 for Drupal developers and site builders - covering both the baseline formatting improvements and the AI-powered authoring layer that's now available in production.

Key updates covered

  • Formatting improvements - enhanced toolbar configuration, new formatting options, and the UX refinements that matter most for content editors working in Drupal every day.
  • AI-powered authoring - CKEditor AI features (AI Chat, Quick Actions, AI Review) and how they integrate with the Drupal editorial workflow.
  • What's coming next - the roadmap for CKEditor in Drupal, including deeper integration with Drupal AI and the agentic content editing layer.

The venue

DrupalCon Chicago 2026 - presented as a lightning talk during the core conference sessions, with the booth providing hands-on follow-up demonstrations for attendees who wanted to dig deeper.
